text.ご自身が海外で集められたアンティークと、マエストロの家具が似合うリフォーム。大き: A renovation to suit the antiques the owner collected abroad, and furniture by the masters. In the large studio-type living-dining-kitchen, rosewood flooring laid in a chequer pattern surrounds a limestone floor, making a room that shows modern pieces and antiques alike to advantage. The balcony is decked throughout, giving a second living room.
text.コンクリートに直接施工するのではなく、木製床を組んだ上にローズウッドの無垢フロー: Rather than fixing straight to the concrete slab, we built a timber floor and laid solid rosewood over it in a chequer pattern. Finished in natural oil; with time the oils in the timber itself deepen the colour and the sheen. Each board is screw-fixed by hand, so the floor is laid with no adhesive.
text.足触りの柔らかなライムストーンをリビングの床に施工し、部屋のアクセントになってい: Limestone, soft underfoot, is laid in the living-room floor and gives the room its accent.
text.水性塗料で仕上げた壁や天井は、ビニールクロスと違い、照明の柔らかな演出が可能です: Walls and ceilings finished in water-based paint take lighting softly, in a way vinyl wallcovering cannot.
